advancedArguments.description: First, execute the 'getApplicationStructure' tool to retrieve and display effective years and months. The user selects a year and month, and their corresponding values (e.g., year '2025' corresponds to '1') are taken from the 'getApplicationStructure' response and used when applying the benefit.

raw.description: First, execute the 'getApplicationStructure' tool to retrieve and display effective years and months. The user selects a year and month, and their corresponding values (e.g., year '2025' corresponds to '1') are taken from the 'getApplicationStructure' response and used when applying the benefit.

yearValue.description: The argument will be used to fetch the effect year corresponding to the year value from the 'getApplicationStructure' API. Example: '2025' → '1'.

monthValue.description: The argument will be used to fetch the effect month corresponding to the month value from the 'getApplicationStructure' API. Example: 'June' → '6'.

amount.description: The amount entered by the user.

requestAmount.description: The requested amount entered by the user.

benComment.description: Optional argument—if a referral is provided, the user can add a benefit comment.
